docs.title: Pythagorean Theorem
docs.text: In a right triangle, the square of the hypotenuse equals the sum of the squares of the other two sides.

docs.title: Statement
docs.text:
For a right triangle with legs a, b and hypotenuse c:

a^2 + b^2 = c^2
